paper.title: Assessing the Benefits of Optimized Agentic AI Systems for Asset Pricing
paper.primary_claim: Agentic AI signals extracted from earnings-announcement text add explanatory power for contemporaneous stock returns beyond standard earnings-surprise benchmarks in real-time out-of-sample evaluation.

hypothesis: Text-derived AI signals available at earnings-announcement time add positive incremental out-of-sample explanatory power beyond an earnings-surprise-only benchmark.

pre_registered_gate.use_if: At least one finalized live out-of-sample quarter has positive delta_R2 for every reported language-model baseline and the best baseline delta_R2 is at least 0.04.
pre_registered_gate.reject_if: The finalized live out-of-sample quarter shows non-positive delta_R2 for a majority of reported language-model baselines or the best baseline delta_R2 is below 0.01.

canonical_real_data.source: Explaining Markets official leaderboard and rules
canonical_real_data.evaluation_design: real-time out-of-sample earnings events with event-specific knowledge_cutoff

q3_2026.note: Preliminary leaderboard only; not used to determine the final verdict.

benchmark: earnings-surprise-only regression benchmark used by Explaining Markets
alternative: language-model signals derived from earnings-call summary or full transcript
claim_boundary: USE applies only to the research principle that announcement-time text-derived AI signals contain incremental explanatory information beyond earnings surprise in live out-of-sample evaluation. It does not establish tradable alpha, positive after-cost returns, or that any specific LLM/agent should receive portfolio capital.
portfolio_implication: Future earnings-event models may include text-derived AI signals as candidate features, but capital allocation requires a separate point-in-time trading test with implementable execution timing, transaction costs, slippage, turnover, and risk metrics.
do_not_use_for: expected-return estimates without a trading test
historical backtests that violate event knowledge_cutoff
claims that optimized agentic AI doubles investable alpha
